units.text: INT. WOMAN - CONTINUOUS
Exeunt SIR JOHN, LADY STUTFIELD, MR. KELVIL and LORD ALFRED.
To LORD ILLINGWORTH.
May I come too?
units.name: GERALD

units.text: Do, my dear boy.
units.name: LORD ILLINGWORTH

units.text: Moves towards door with MRS. ALLONBY and GERALD.
LADY CAROLINE enters , looks rapidly round and goes off in opposite direction to that taken by SIR JOHN and LADY STUTFIELD.
Gerald!
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: What, mother!
units.name: GERALD

units.text: Exit LORD ILLINGWORTH with MRS. ALLONBY.
It is getting late. Let us go home.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: My dear mother. Do let us wait a little longer. Lord Illingworth is so delightful, and, by the way, mother, I have a great surprise for you. We are starting for India at the end of this month.
units.name: GERALD

units.text: Let us go home.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: If you really want to, of course, mother, but I must bid good-bye to Lord Illingworth first. I’ll be back in five minutes.
units.name: GERALD

units.text: Exit .
Let him leave me if he chooses, but not with him—not with him! I couldn’t bear it.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: Walks up and down .
Enter HESTER.
What a lovely night it is, Mrs. Arbuthnot.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Is it?
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: Mrs. Arbuthnot, I wish you would let us be friends. You are so different from the other women here. When you came into the Drawing-room this evening, somehow you brought with you a sense of what is good and pure in life. I had been foolish. There are things that are right to say, but that may be said at the wrong time and to the wrong people.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I heard what you said. I agree with it, Miss Worsley.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: I didn’t know you had heard it. But I knew you would agree with me. A woman who has sinned should be punished, shouldn’t she?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Yes.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: She shouldn’t be allowed to come into the society of good men and women?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: She should not.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: And the man should be punished in the same way?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: In the same way. And the children, if there are children, in the same way also?
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: Yes, it is right that the sins of the parents should be visited on the children. It is a just law. It is God’s law.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: It is one of God’s terrible laws.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: Moves away to fireplace .
You are distressed about your son leaving you, Mrs. Arbuthnot?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Yes.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: Do you like him going away with Lord Illingworth? Of course there is position, no doubt, and money, but position and money are not everything, are they?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: They are nothing; they bring misery.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: Then why do you let your son go with him?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: He wishes it himself.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: But if you asked him he would stay, would he not?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: He has set his heart on going.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: He couldn’t refuse you anything. He loves you too much. Ask him to stay. Let me send him in to you. He is on the terrace at this moment with Lord Illingworth. I heard them laughing together as I passed through the Music-room.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Don’t trouble, Miss Worsley, I can wait. It is of no consequence.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: No, I’ll tell him you want him. Do—do ask him to stay.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Exit HESTER.
He won’t come—I know he won’t come.
units.name: MRS. ARBUTHNOT

units.text: Enter LADY CAROLINE.
She looks round anxiously .
Enter GERALD.
Mr. Arbuthnot, may I ask you is Sir John anywhere on the terrace?
units.name: LADY CAROLINE
